title: Social media content
description: Character design, illustration, and social media content for Té Supremo, a Chilean premium tea brand with a playful, personality-forward approach to the market. The project included an original brand mascot, monthly content calendar templates, and live broadcast graphics.
challenge: Chilean consumers associate tea with either luxury calm or utility — Té Supremo wanted neither. They wanted to own the playful, fun end of the market, targeting younger audiences who drink tea as part of a lifestyle, not a ritual.
solution: Created an original illustrated character — a loose, expressive figure with personality and versatility — that could appear across posts, stickers, packaging, and live streams. The character's visual tone is deliberately imperfect: hand-drawn, energetic, and always slightly surprising.
result: Té Supremo's Instagram grew from 800 to 8,400 followers in 6 months post-launch. The mascot character became the brand's most shared asset, with fans creating their own variations and tagging the brand.
